items.title: 1.9 Period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein bonding ke rujhan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.9, printed page 16.

blocks.text: Group 1, 2 aur 3 ke oxides (maslan Na₂O) mein ionic character zyada hai. Yeh oxides giant ionic lattices (ions ka bara jaal) ki shakal mein hote hain, jin mein ulte charge wale ions ke darmiyan mazboot electrostatic forces hoti hain. Group 4, 5, 6 aur 7 ke oxides (maslan SO₂) zyada covalent hain. Yeh covalent molecules ki shakal mein hote hain jin ke darmiyan kamzor intermolecular forces (molecules ke beech ki kashish) hoti hain. Yeh tabdeeli is liye hai ke period mein electronegativity barhti hai aur ionic character kam hota hai.

Oxides ki tarah group 1, 2 aur 3 ke chlorides (maslan NaCl) zyada tar ionic hain, aur group 4, 5, 6 aur 7 ke elements ke chlorides (maslan PCl₅) covalent hain. Chlorides mein covalent character is liye barhta hai ke halogen aur doosre atom ki electronegativity ka farq kam hota jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan purana numbering istemal karti hai: group 1, 2, 3 = Na, Mg, Al; group 4, 5, 6, 7 = Si, P, S, Cl (aaj ke groups 14 se 17).

blocks.caption: Period 3 mein bonding
rows: Ionic: giant lattices, mazboot electrostatic forces (Na₂O)
O ya Cl se electronegativity ka bara farq

blocks.prompt: Sodium oxide bohat zyada temperature par pighalta hai jab ke sulfur dioxide kamre ke temperature par gas hai. Is ka bonding se kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Sodium oxide giant ionic lattice hai jis ke ions mazboot electrostatic forces se bandhe hain; inhein torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye. Sulfur dioxide covalent molecules ka bana hai jo aapas mein sirf kamzor intermolecular forces se jure hain, is liye yeh gas hai.

items: Na, Mg, Al ke oxides aur chlorides ionic (giant lattices); Si, P, S, Cl ke covalent molecules, kyun ke O ya Cl se electronegativity ka farq period mein kam hota jata hai.
